name: chloectx
description: Your chats with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and a persona card drawn from them, in one file on your Mac that Claude reads.
long_description:
ChloeCtx keeps a memory of your own: the chats you had with ChatGPT, Claude.ai and Gemini, and a persona card of what they say about you, each line linked to the chats it came from. It is one ChloeDB file on your Mac; nothing leaves it.

After installing, download an export of your chats (ChatGPT: Settings, Data controls, Export data; Claude: Settings, Privacy, Export data; Gemini: Google Takeout) and tell Claude: "Import my ChatGPT export from Downloads, then draft my persona card." Claude finds the export, imports it, drafts the card from what you wrote and shows it to you to confirm. From then on it reads the card and searches your past chats when that helps.
